features.name: No-Checkout Monetization Stack
features.description: ENV-gated unified monetization stack. All slots render null when their env var is unset. Single programmatic ad network selector (AdProvider). ResultMonetization inserted below cost result. ads.txt redirect support. .env.example fully documented.
features.evidence: 2026-07-01: (1) src/lib/monetization.ts — central config; parseFeaturedPartners, parseAdProvider, parsePrimaryCTAType, getMonetizationConfig; VERTICAL_DEFAULT_CTA_TYPE='call'. (2) src/components/monetization/AdProvider.tsx — single network selector; adsense reuses existing AdUnit; ezoic/raptive each inject one <script>; none renders null; never two providers. (3) src/components/monetization/ResultMonetization.tsx — PrimaryIntentCTA (call/cpl/affiliate/none), DisplaySlot (AdProvider, lazy IO), FeaturedPartnerTableBlock (FTC disclosure inline above table), SponsorSlot, EmailCapture reuse. (4) src/components/calculator/cost-result.tsx — ResultMonetization inserted directly below the cost card; existing AdUnit/EmailCapture removed from page to avoid two units. (5) src/app/[state]/[slug]/page.tsx — in-content AdUnits routed through AdProvider; page-level email capture + result-area AdUnit removed (now inside ResultMonetization). (6) src/app/ads.txt/route.ts — 301 redirect when NEXT_PUBLIC_ADSTXT_REDIRECT_URL is set; AdSense line preserved as default. (7) .env.example — all monetization keys documented. (8) tests/monetization.test.ts — 58 unit tests: parseFeaturedPartners (8), parseAdProvider (7), parsePrimaryCTAType (7), getMonetizationConfig env-unset (16), getMonetizationConfig env-set (13), single-provider invariant (3). Gate: lint 0 errors, 251/251 tests, build 833 pages (0 TS errors).
acceptance: lib/monetization.ts: getMonetizationConfig returns nulls/false/[] when all env vars unset
lib/monetization.ts: parseFeaturedPartners returns [] for invalid/empty JSON
